class.description: SDFGrid2DControl (Tier 3 UI Tool) Composite Editor & Runtime Control wrapping `SDFGrid2DCanvas` AND an optional collapsible `HeatmapGrid` companion view, with CSG brush controls, Marching Squares iso-contour scrubbing, and a Chladni standing-wave modal synthesizer (`IdeamCymatics` bridge). Part of IdeamGeometry (2D/3D polygons, Voronoi diagrams, SDF grids, and tensor fields).
